dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive laser image dataset for real time measurement of wheelset geometric parameters

description: A comprehensive laser image dataset for real-time measurement of wheelset geometric parameters is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yuezeng Song et al. Railway transportation has experienced significant growth worldwide, offering numerous benefits to society. Most railway accidents are caused by wheelset faults so it’s significant to monitor wheelset conditions. Therefore, we need to collect wheelset images, repaint them, extract laser stripe centerlines, construct 3D contour, and measure their geometric parameters to judge the wheelset’s conditions. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: Image, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 783803943 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
